what_happened: Discovered that web-research-agent.md/web-implementation-agent.md load context via a static per-agent @-reference list, not via index.json load_when queries -- so the manifest dependency edit alone would not have made 'Astro work auto-load the base TypeScript context' true. Surfaced the concrete fix (one @-pointer line to typescript/README.md in each web agent file) before the plan/implementation phase, avoiding an incomplete-looking-complete deliverable.
